R5C-camp-camp-0003.recDirections: Located southwest of the community of Tatla Lake. Approximately 1 km east of Tatla Lake on Hwy 20, turn south onto the Tatlayoko Lake Road. Travel approximately 4 km and turn right onto the Bluff Lake Road. Continue about 12 km to the Horn Lake Recreation Site.
